name: DJI Avata 2
notes: cruisePowerW = battery energy / time to fly the max flight distance (13.0 km at 43.2 kph) = 31.7 Wh / 18.1 min = 105.3 W at 12.0 m/s. DJI flew from 100% to a forced landing in still air at sea level, so this is an average over the whole pack. The same manual gives 23 min at 21.6 kph, which is 82.7 W at 6 m/s. Climb efficiency 0.3 is a conservative planning value, not a vendor figure; replace it with a measurement.

source.reference: DJI Avata 2 User Manual v1.0, Specifications: Takeoff Weight approx. 377 g; Max Flight Distance 13.0 km (flying forward at 43.2 kph, windless, sea level, 100% to 0%); Intelligent Flight Battery Energy 31.7 Wh
